hints.title: One-Based Base 26 Representation
hints.text: The spreadsheet column title represents a base-26 numeral system, but without a zero digit: digits range from one (A) through twenty-six (Z).

hints.title: Pre-Decrement Base Alignment Invariant
hints.text: Subtracting one from the column number before each modulo operation converts the 1-based range [1, 26] into the standard 0-based range [0, 25].

hints.title: Repeated Modulo Conversion Procedure
hints.text: While the column number is strictly positive, subtract one. Extract remainder modulo twenty-six, convert to character A plus remainder, and divide column number by twenty-six. Reverse the collected characters and return as a string.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(log26 N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard base-26 conversion without shifting produces incorrect characters for multiples of 26 because there is no zero digit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Repeated division by 26 executes in O(log26 N) steps using O(1) auxiliary space beyond the output string.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should explain why columnNumber -= 1 is necessary before each modulo step to convert from 1-indexed to 0-indexed arithmetic.
